architecture.pattern: Strict JSON CLI with explicit Limitless SDK and Base RPC adapters
architecture.isolation_boundaries: Prediction journal, capital and permissions isolated from flashloan execution; separate paper/live and fixture/production state; live disabled by default
execution_flow: Validate closed schema and config pin
Normalize public market and account identity
Build exact SDK unsigned order and bounded approval plan
Reserve cash and inventory under account lock
Persist signed transaction identity or dispatch intent before effects
Submit once; recover unknown acceptance by clientOrderId
Confirm receipt-backed fills and canonical finality
Apply FIFO, fee bounds and redemption; retain cleanup when placement is disabled

inputs.units: USDC and shares: unsigned six-decimal raw strings; prices: integer ppm
inputs.credentials: host env references and owner-only signer key file; no secrets in input

outputs.bookUnits: REST sizes and reward threshold already raw6-decimal quantities; only prices converted
outputs.rewardMinimum: LP rewards and adjustedMidpoint only; not trade admission
outputs.gas: Base L2 execution plus reserved L1/operator fees; variable L1 charges are not transaction-capped

test_criteria: EDGE-01 schema, provider identity and paper isolation
EDGE-02 real SDK amount/signature/HMAC parity and finite approvals
EDGE-03 signed exact-plan/session authority before signing
EDGE-04 subprocess restart, lost acceptance, partial fills and cancel race
EDGE-05 canonical fills, FIFO, redemption, corruption and conflicts
Dead lock recovery refuses living PID; reservation cannot change grant
Installed schema matches digest pin and prediction routing
Public health is independent of funded acceptance
REST raw-size parsing rejects unsafe numbers and preserves large integer strings; reward threshold never gates smaller trades
Public-data paper lifecycle performs no authenticated requests or provider writes
Repository regression suite and recorded limitations
